title: Concrete restricted CE total and sections inclusion
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $K$ a bounded-below cochain complex of abelian sheaves on its small étale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and $T$ an étale termwise hypercohomology presentation of $K$ [def-weil-pbc-termwise-hypercohomology-presentation]. Let $q$ be any integer. Define $I_q=\sigma_{\ge q}T.I$, truncating the complex-degree index and retaining nonnegative resolution degree, and $R_q=\operatorname{Tot}((I_q\text{ extended in resolution degree}).\mathrm{flip})$. Define augmentation components from $\sigma_{\ge q}K$ using the truncation inclusion, $T.a$, the degreewise truncation projection, and the resolution-degree-zero total summand. For abelian Grothendieck categories $A,B$, an additive $F:A\to B$, and a rowwise bounded-below bicomplex $I$, define $\operatorname{Tot}(FI)\cong F\operatorname{Tot}(I)$ from the extension natural isomorphism and coproduct comparison: each diagonal has finitely many nonzero terms. Using this canonical comparison, define $s_q:\Gamma R_q\to\operatorname{Tot}(\Gamma T.I)$ by totalizing $I_q\to T.I$. No isomorphism is chosen from an unproved existence theorem.
